description: This Java class 'DimensionConverter' provides conversion and validation logic for dimension units in Android development, including unit recognition, variant generation, and documentation.

classes.name: DimensionConverter
classes.description: A converter class for Android dimension units, implementing value conversion, variant generation, and documentation provision.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Returns possible dimension unit variants based on the XML element context.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a dimension to its canonical form.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the dimension value.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Provides an error message if the dimension string is invalid or contains unknown units.

methods.name: getUnitFromValue
methods.description: Extracts the unit part from a dimension value string.

methods.name: getIntegerPrefix
methods.description: Extracts the numeric prefix from a dimension string.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns HTML formatted documentation for a given dimension value.
